routes.title: About IRG Media | Creator judgment and connected delivery
routes.description: IRG brings creator judgment, campaign ownership and retained learning together for travel, hospitality and lifestyle brands. Explore its operating principles.

routes.title: How IRG works: Frame, Assemble, Run, Learn | IRG Media
routes.description: Inspect IRG’s four campaign stages: responsibilities, client inputs, deliverables and decision points from the agreed brief to the next performance review.

routes.title: Discuss your creator campaign | IRG Media
routes.description: Share your brand, market, timing and campaign context with IRG. Use the project enquiry form or email reyan@irgmedia.org to discuss the next step.

routes.title: IRG Media | Travel, Hospitality & Lifestyle Influencer Marketing
routes.description: IRG Media is an influencer marketing agency for travel, hospitality and lifestyle brands. Creator sourcing, campaign operations and performance learning.

routes.title: Creator Sourcing Framework | IRG Media
routes.description: Explore IRG’s existing Creator Sourcing Framework resource page.

routes.title: Influencer Marketing Services | IRG Media
routes.description: IRG Media plans influencer marketing for travel, hospitality and lifestyle brands. Explore creator sourcing, campaign management and performance learning.

routes.title: Why IRG: creator context that carries forward | IRG Media
routes.description: See why IRG retains creator rationale, campaign decisions and performance learning so the next brief starts with context rather than reconstruction.

routes.title: Always-on creator programme methodology | IRG Media
routes.description: Inspect an illustrative ongoing creator programme: retained context, recurring briefs, delivery records and a performance review that informs the next cycle.

routes.title: Campaign operations methodology example | IRG Media
routes.description: An illustrative creator campaign record: briefing, coordination, approvals, delivery and review.

routes.title: Holafly creator programme case study | IRG Media
routes.description: Holafly’s always-on programme connected continuous sourcing, advance planning, refreshed briefs and repeat collaboration.

routes.title: Hospitality and travel brief example | IRG Media
routes.description: Illustrative hospitality planning: audience, experience, hosted-stay arrangements, coverage and reporting limits.

routes.title: Client work and methodology examples | IRG Media
routes.description: Explore Holafly’s creator programme process, then inspect clearly labelled campaign operations, ongoing programme and hospitality brief examples.
